title: Dollar investors, rupee investors
news: Amid calls to cut taxes for foreign investors, the Finance Minister asked: 'If you pitch for dollar investors, what about rupee investors?'
syllabus: Impartiality and non-partisanship; Fairness in public policy
link: Public policy must treat like cases alike: concessions that favour foreign over domestic investors for the same income break fairness and impartiality, even when the aim of attracting capital is legitimate. Good ends do not justify unequal means.
question: "Fairness in public policy means treating like cases alike." Examine with an example from economic policy.

title: Empathy across state lines
news: When Cyclone Murasu struck Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu sent 500 electricity workers in 25 teams to restore its neighbour's power.
syllabus: Empathy, compassion and tolerance towards the weaker sections; Public service values
link: Public service that ends at the state border is incomplete; helping a neighbouring state's people in a crisis shows empathy and solidarity as public values, beyond political rivalries.
question: "In a disaster, empathy must not stop at administrative boundaries." Discuss with examples.
